page.layout: One printed title page: title block at top centre, a motto set in italic below, a printer's imprint at the foot, a printer's device between; a page number bottom right and a pencilled number bottom left (not printed text, so not transcribed).

l.i: Vnum petij à Iehova, hoc requiram; vt habitem in Domo Iehova, omnibus diebus vitæ meæ, vt videam pulchritudinem Iehovæ, & quaram in Templo eius.

page.notes: The title is printed in large roman capitals; "Eaccalaureos" in the scan reads "Baccalaureos" in the large type, transcribed as printed in the scan's first letter, which is a damaged B. The motto line 1 "Vnum petij" has a lowered j, transcribed as ij. Pencilled marks (a "2" at upper right, "1095" at lower left) and the printed page number "64" are not transcribed as text beyond the page number. The device between the imprint lines is an engraved emblem and is not transcribed. Word "Iehova," in motto line 1 has a comma as printed.
